# UnmodifiableList

**Class** · `ironwood.ds.UnmodifiableList`

```java
public final class UnmodifiableList<E extends Object> implements Iterable<E>
```

**Implements:** [`Iterable<E>`](../lang/Iterable.md)

A read-only view of an [`ArrayList`](ArrayList.md). Changes made through the backing
list remain visible through this view.
